name: catalog
description: Read-model app catalog for Hasna distribution. Seeds hasna.app.v1 records into a local SQLite catalog, exposes CLI and MCP read surfaces, and can generate a static public catalog site.

serviceSurfaces.name: api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The read-only HTTP API does ship: `catalog serve` binds Bun.serve on 127.0.0.1:8797 (overridable via CATALOG_HOST/CATALOG_PORT or --host/--port) and answers GET /health, /v1/apps, /v1/apps/:appId and /v1/search. It is a local development convenience, not a supported service surface: there is no catalog-serve bin, no GET /ready or GET /version endpoint, and no authentication of any kind, so binding it to a non-loopback host exposes the catalog read model unauthenticated.

health.description: Returns { status, service, version, apps }; unauthenticated like the rest of the HTTP surface.

waivedStorageEngines.reason: Catalog is currently a local read model backed by SQLite only; PostgreSQL support is not implemented yet.
